cases.request: An outside agent tries to approve its own order

steps.text: Its order (Valio kevytmaito 1 l laktoositon UHT, 30 packs) is held for the chef.
It called approve itself: refused (403). Ops logs the attempt; nothing changed.
Over MCP its key gets 15 tools, none of them approve.
